notes.title: Version 3.0
notes.content:
Updates with bug fixes and gameplay improvements

- Added hand movements with the steering wheel

- Added another flashing light next to the motel room (to direct the player)

- Interactions with objects by pressing a key instead of touching

- Improved truck detailing (windshield wipers)
